evidence.text: Proofbacked develops an AI-powered compliance platform that automates supplier assessments, regulatory compliance workflows and evidence management while keeping decision-making under human control.

The compliance team you need. Without hiring one. AI does the compliance work. A named person makes every decision, and every decision is proven. One platform for your customers and your suppliers. Book a demo Watch it work For anyone whose decisions can be questioned: by a regulator, a customer, an auditor or the board. See it work · 1:20 Compliance is decisions. Watch the AI prepare them. It reads every supplier, contract and certificate, shows what each answer rests on, and stops where your judgment starts. You decide, and every decision is proven. Compliance kept AI out, for good reason The AI that refuses to guess. So we built one that never decides for you. It prepares, asks and follows up. It never approves, seals or signs. Reading, comparing, drafting and chasing are its job. Approvals, tiers, seals and anything sent outside Proofbacked stay with a named person, enforced in the product, not left to a prompt. “Approve Polarlink.” I can’t approve suppliers. Ingrid holds that mandate. Shall I open the decision for her? “Set Ravnsund Cloud as non-critical.” That’s a decision for the domain owner. I’ve prepared the options and the sources. “Send this to the supplier.” Here is the draft. It waits in the queue until someone with authority sends it. “Does Polarlink keep data in the EEA?” Their statement says yes, the audit report says no. I won’t guess. I’ve put both in front of Ingrid. Know. Decide. Prove. Two years later, someone asks why. You just show them. Who decided, under which mandate, on what evidence, and that nothing has changed since. Every decision becomes a receipt. It is tamper-evident, and anyone you share it with can verify it. No account needed. Review the findings, confirm the claims and record the reasoning. Every decision becomes a receipt. See how it works A few useful answers. What makes the shared context useful? + It puts policies, source statements, requirements and commitments into the same context as the work. Your AI colleague can prepare a comparison or draft from that context, and your team can review its basis. Is Proofbacked a replacement for judgment? + No. Preparation and judgment have different responsibilities. Your AI colleague prepares the work; authorised people decide what applies and what happens next. Approving, sealing and signing are refused to the AI in the product. Do teams have to work from separate answers? + The purpose of the shared foundation is to let departments work from the same evidence while keeping their responsibilities distinct.
